description: The newly drawn 68th District includes parts of Rockford, Loves Park, Cherry Valley, and Belvidere Find out if you’re in the 68th District Visit the State of Illinois Board of Elections website to find your district. On the site, follow these instructions: 1. Enter your address 2. Scroll down to “State Representative” 3. The site will display your district.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Kathy Easton
title: 68th District - Kathy Easton for Illinois State Representative
